source: Renderer for the diarized-transcript outputs of workflows/speech-transcription.json (Azure AI Speech batch + diarization, EU) and of any whisperx-transcribe-diarize JSON. Turn model, HH:MM:SS timestamps and speaker legend follow the byte-verified claude-account-export/skills/whisperx-transcribe-diarize/scripts/format_transcript.py; the palette is the Euronext house style (templates/enx-theme.json), per agents/document_agents_addendum.md. Speaker names come from the approved contract (speakerNames), never from the engine - the skill's relabel_speakers.py is an upstream editorial step. Audio clips stay on POST /api/speaker_clips (whisperx renderer).
